title: Sealed: the thirteen-year cicadas (a control that must pass)

data.source: GBIF occurrence index, genus Magicicada, records dated April to June, 2008 to 2026, in a box around Baton Rouge and in Mississippi
data.licence: Counts only. The records carry CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC licences (GBIF.org)

claim_kind: prediction (sealed before the event; not yet scored)
prediction: A control. Brood XXII of the thirteen-year cicadas comes out in spring 2027: at least 100 GBIF records of Magicicada dated April to June 2027 in the box around Baton Rouge.
baseline: The field's calendar says the same (2014 + 13 = 2027). Persistence expects 8.0 records, the mean of the last four years 18.5, the decoy 24.0: none of them expects an emergence.
status_line: A sealed envelope. Opens on or after 15 July 2027.
why: The event has not happened, so nothing could be scored tonight. The envelope is sealed (seal 1b569369c723...) and will be scored by its own frozen rule when it opens.
